preset.name: GTM & marketing
preset.tagline: What's working in go-to-market and marketing right now
preset.description: The whole GTM archetype: outbound and signals, GTM engineering, AI SDRs and sales tools, plus launch videos, campaigns, positioning, and content. Powers the marketing channel digest.

focus.audience: the marketing and GTM team at an AI sales startup (Rox)
care_about: Signal-based selling and outbound playbooks with real results: sequences, reply rates, meetings booked
GTM engineering: Clay workflows, enrichment, data waterfalls, and automating the sales process
AI SDRs and AI sales agents: what actually works, what doesn't, and real numbers
Sales tools: launches, features, and pricing from Clay, Monaco, Gong, Attio, Apollo, Unify, Common Room, and others
Founder-led sales, pipeline building, win rates, and sales leadership takes backed by data
Pricing and packaging moves in B2B and AI software
Launch videos and product launches that were marketed well, and why they worked
Ad campaigns, billboards, stunts, and rebrands from tech companies
Positioning, messaging, landing pages, and copy, with real examples
Content and social strategy that's working: founder-led content, short video, newsletters, community
skip: Generic motivational sales content and engagement-bait lead magnets ('comment PLAYBOOK and I'll DM you')
Politics, regulation, macro, and stock moves
Big-lab model launches unless they change how sales teams work
Engagement bait ('comment TEMPLATE and I'll send it') and generic marketing platitudes
Infrastructure, chips, and technical AI research
